vb_textbox.text: There will be ebbs and flows of points. Try and keep consistent with your choice and it will pay off down the line. I almost exclusively chose the maroon mushroom in the teal/maroon split and the purple mushroom in the purple/brown split. This lead me comfortably to 1000+ points. As I worked out that if you average at least 5 points per mushroom, you will hit 1000 around the point the session finishes.Good luck, I believe in you!
